placeholder: This screen will arrive in a later version.
confirm_writes_one: {{count, number}} new file will be written to the target folders.
confirm_writes_other: {{count, number}} new files will be written to the target folders.
confirm_trash_one: {{count, number}} source goes to the trash — each only after its copies are in place.
confirm_trash_other: {{count, number}} sources go to the trash — each only after its copies are in place.
confirm_renamed_one: {{count, number}} will be renamed in place (not copied and not sent to the trash).
confirm_renamed_other: {{count, number}} will be renamed in place (not copied and not sent to the trash).
confirm_kept_one: {{count, number}} will stay where they are.
confirm_kept_other: {{count, number}} will stay where they are.
confirm_to_trash: Trash targets: {{n, number}} files go to the trash after every copy of the run is in place.
confirm_kept_targets: Keep targets: {{n, number}} files are kept, untouched.
confirm_outside_one: {{count, number}} file outside the plan (to sort, unmatched, unchanged) will not be touched.

confirm_skipped_undo: Files changed after the scan are skipped. The run can be undone from its report.

confirm_pilot_rest: The other files of the plan stay untouched until you continue yourself.
block_no_plan: No plan yet: it builds itself once the config can be read.
block_server_plan: This is a server plan: it is not run here. Run it on the server with gallery apply.
block_updating: The plan is refreshing for changed files, config or decisions — wait for it to finish.
block_no_files: The plan has no files to process.
block_pilot_open: The pilot is done and waits for a decision: continue with the rest or undo the pilot.
result_stopped_anomalies: Stopped: results differ from the sources ({{anomalies, number}}), {{notStarted, number}} not started
result_stopped: Stopped: {{done, number}} of {{total, number}} processed, {{notStarted, number}} not started
result_check_errors: Check found errors: {{failed, number}} of {{total, number}}
result_errors: Finished with errors: {{failed, number}} of {{total, number}}
result_checked_skipped: Checked: {{done, number}} of {{total, number}}, skipped {{skipped, number}}
result_done_skipped: Done: {{done, number}} of {{total, number}}, skipped {{skipped, number}}
result_check_passed_one: Check passed: {{count, number}} file can be processed
result_check_passed_other: Check passed: {{count, number}} files can be processed
row_stale: changed after the plan — left untouched
pilot_stopped: Pilot stopped: results differ from the sources ({{anomalies, number}})
pilot_mismatch_one: Pilot: {{count, number}} file, mismatches with the sources: {{anomalies, number}}
pilot_mismatch_other: Pilot: {{count, number}} files, mismatches with the sources: {{anomalies, number}}
pilot_errors_one: Pilot: {{count, number}} file, with errors: {{failed, number}}
pilot_errors_other: Pilot: {{count, number}} files, with errors: {{failed, number}}

pilot_clean_other: Pilot: {{count, number}} files, no mismatches with the sources
sync_unavailable: Syncthing unavailable: {{reason}}. The run is not blocked.
sync_no_folders: The plan does not touch synced folders (or they are already paused).
run_locked_no_files: The plan has no files to run.
ask_ai_unknown_one: Ask AI ({{count, number}} file, price unknown)
ask_ai_unknown_other: Ask AI ({{count, number}} files, price unknown)
flow_build_failed: The plan could not be built (see the reason above).
flow_builds_itself: The plan builds itself: it reads the sources from the config and assigns files to targets. The files themselves are not changed.
flow_ai_manual: AI is not called until you press “Ask AI” yourself.
flow_undecided: Undecided files will not be part of this run and stay where they are.
flow_config_unread: Config could not be read, the plan is not refreshed
warn_series_split: A series was split across targets: {{a}} and {{b}}
decision_review_none: AI is unsure and suggested no target
decision_unchanged: Already in place or filtered out by an exclude mask
cost_tokens: AI: {{input, number}} in, {{output, number}} out tokens
ask_note: Without AI these files do not make it into the plan. Only files without a cached answer cost money.
ask_costly: This AI request will cost more than $1
ask_estimate_note: This is an estimate: no API calls, based on the number of files without a cached answer.
pilot_unreadable: The pilot result could not be read
pilot_accept: Continue despite mismatches with the sources
pilot_note: The pilot did not touch the other files of the plan; the plan refreshes by itself. Continuing asks for confirmation, like a regular run.
app_reload_dirty_hint: Unsaved editor changes are kept; saving checks whether the file changed
busy_scan: A scan is running — wait for it to finish.
busy_run: A plan run is in progress — wait for it to finish.
busy_export: A server plan export is running — wait for it to finish.
busy_undo: An undo is running — wait for it to finish.
busy_retry: A retry of the failed files is being prepared — wait for it to finish.
syncpause_load_failed: Could not tell whether Syncthing is paused: {{error}}
trace_conf_low: low, accepted by the “Accept uncertain” flag
trace_rebuild: Rebuild the plan to see the file in its new place.
pipe_no_match: the step's mask did not match
summary_unknown_title: This target is no longer in the config
summary_none: No file landed in a target

explain_filter_source: {{what}}: the source is not in the list [{{sources}}]
explain_ai_not_asked: AI was not asked: no saved answer (candidates: {{candidates}}).
triage_already: The config already contains this change
triage_saved: Saved to the config: {{label}}. The previous version is next to it as .bak.
triage_no_suggestions: No changes are suggested for files without an extension: edit the config by hand.
triage_ignore_source: Always ignore in the whole source
triage_folder_hint: By default files stay in place and are only renamed.
triage_will_change: The config will change like this:
block_report_unreadable: The report could not be read.
block_server_run: This is a run on a server: undo it there, with the command below.

block_unfinished: The run is not finished: undo it first.
block_no_failed: This run has no failed files.
block_plan_missing_retry: The report's plan is not next to it.

undo_restore_other: {{count, number}} sources are restored from the trash.
undo_rename_back_one: {{count, number}} renamed file will get the old name back.

undo_remove_outputs_other: {{count, number}} copies will be deleted from the target folders.
undo_nothing: Nothing to restore per the report: the undo will only mark the run as undone.

retry_failed_one: {{count, number}} failed file: the copies they managed to place are deleted (their sources were not touched).
retry_failed_other: {{count, number}} failed files: the copies they managed to place are deleted (their sources were not touched).
retry_new_plan: A new plan is built next to the old one from those that have not changed since.
retry_nothing_runs: Nothing runs right away: the plan opens on the Sort screen, where you run it.
undo_result: Sources restored: {{restored, number}}, copies deleted: {{removed, number}}.

history_none_server_dir: Server reports arrive in the export folder.
history_none_server_pick: To see server reports, choose an export folder there too.
history_server_reports: Server reports — from the export folder
history_choose: Choose a run on the left.

busy_retry_short: A retry is being prepared — wait for it to finish.
history_report_unreadable: The report could not be read

history_cancelling: No new files are started; the one in progress is finished.
